notes.title: EVERING 2 is OUT NOW! (April Fool's 2025)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084367/b34e9a94faba6799b35e18ab902fa7c1ff4780ab.png[/img]


[h2]It's time to settle down![/h2]

The long-awaited sequel to the acclaimed video game EVERING is here! EVERING 2: Put a Ring on it! Explore a new genre to bring to life a new legend that will lead Eldar and his friends to embark on an exciting adventure.

In EVERING 2: Put a Ring on it! you will have the opportunity to get to know the main characters of EVERING better and develop a closer relationship. Let your feelings and emotions take over and find your ideal partner!

Forget about that game with crusty old graphics, turn-based combat without any logic, lore-dumps every five steps and wasted characters!


[h3]Features[/h3]

[list]
[*]300+ hours of gameplay (as long as you leave the game open for more than 300 hours)
[*]A (1) fantastic soundtrack
[*]Texts completely in English (I have it written also in Spanish, but I don't know how to add the translation)
[*]More than 7k words (this is true)
[*]4 dateable characters (kinda)[/list]


💍

[h2]Who will you choose?[/h2]

👉👉[h1][url=https://purpurest.itch.io/evering-2-put-a-ring-on-it]Play for FREE here [/url][/h1]

notes.title: EVERING's 1st Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084367/16ed9281f64f59dec5a150b478ee962489521e9f.png[/img]

It's been a year since we released [i]EVERING[/i]. Yep, one full year.

Of course we want to celebrate with our biggest discount yet, to commemorate such a joyous occasion. So if you still haven't played [i]EVERING[/i], for the next three days you can get it [b]50% OFF! [/b] Also, we are giving away some keys in our socials, check it out :)

Long gone are the days of making maps, writing dialogue, drawing tiles and item icons, animating skills... Those [b]3 years of hard work[/b] that we hope have led to a quality final product. Remember that [b]Purpure Studio is a 2 people team[/b], with our main jobs and stuff, and although we have had the help of our friends and a lot of nice strangers from the internet, we don't have the same capacity as a big studio. But we have as much or even more passion for videogames as any of them.

[b]Thank you[/b] for joining us in this adventure, fur buying and playing our game, for giving us your opinions and ideas to make [i]EVERING[/i] a better game, and a special thanks to those who have posted a review on Steam (it help us A LOT!). We are very proud of our game and very pleased with the reception it has received. [i]Eldar, Lue, Jövla, Laric[/i] and [i]Qibayn[/i] will be in our hearts forever. Making and releasing a game is an experience one cannot forget easily.

While we are working in our next game, there's still some places [i]EVERING [/i]can go ;)


Thank you so much!
Purpure Studio

notes.title: EVERING - Update v1.1.0!
notes.notes:
It's been almost 6 months now since we released the full version of [b]EVERING[/b] and today we bring you the v1.1.0 update which includes a much requested feature. 

If you have left something unfinished in a previous area, you will now be able to go back in the Flying Thing™ and cross it off your list. We've also added a dedicated button (Keyboard and Gamepad) to directly open the Errands Notebook.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084367/f87a016c7773262e14537d91ee4bc27459e73340.gif[/img]

We have also made some other changes, take a look:

[list]
[*]Return to previous areas in the Flying Thing™ (only available in the final stretch of the game). A new NPC awaits you in [spoiler]The Entrails, returning before making the final decision[/spoiler].

[*]Added a quick access to the Errand Book (E on keyboard, Menu/Select on gamepad, you may have to configure yourself for your current save).

[*]Modified some previous zones to make them coherent with the progress of the story.

[*]Fixed numerous minor bugs.

[*]Fixed several translation errors.

[*]New logo screen at the start of the game. Did you know that the game was made by a studio called Purpure Studio? Well, now you know.
[/list]

There's not a lot in this update but we had to change some systems from the ground up in order to make it work, that's why we consider this one an update and not a patch. From now on you shouldn't expect new updates as we are shifted our focus to a new project, but we'll continue to make patches to fix the issues that may come up. All we can say about our new game right now is that it's not related to EVERING in any way, no DLC, no sequel (maybe in the future, who knows). Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/PurpureSt_]Twitter[/url] to stay up to date ;)
 
Remember, you can report to us any issue you found via [url=mailto:purpurest@gmail.com]email[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/PurpureSt_]DM on Twitter[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.gg/7Zxk6bDt2M]Discord[/url].

As always, thank you for playing [b]EVERING[/b] and for your support and suggestions that make our game better.

Purpure Studio

notes.title: EVERING v1.0 is here!
notes.notes:
Today, February 28th, EVERING says goodbye to the Early Access label and welcomes the final chapter. This third and last chapter is called "A Tear in Time" and it's the conclusion to Eldar's journey.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NcLyWss.gif[/img]

It took us a little more than three years, but as of today it's possible to enjoy the complete game from start to finish and we are very proud of the result. 

In addition to working on the last chapter, we have made numerous improvements to the previously released content. 


This is the list of changes made from the last version:

    • More than 5 hours of new content (more than 25h in total!), new cities and areas, new enemies and characters, as well as the conclusion of the story.

    • More than 30 Steam achievements!

    • Stunning new battle menu.

    • New and beautiful main menu. Scenes are randomized :)

    • New character portraits based on our amazing key art. 

    • Errands Notebook: Keep track of side quests (errands) and keep up to date with your progress.

    • Errand Boards: They let you know if there are errands available in the area and where to find them. Look for them in the inns of each town.

    • Initial area (Riropó) completely revamped.

    • Interact with the maps hung on the walls to see the world map. Do you remember where you have been?

    • Blacksmiths: They'll improve a certain weapon if you have the right item.

    • Banks: Save money in the banks you'll find in each city and you might win interesting prizes when you reach certain amounts (exclusive equipment!).

    • Surprise!: Catch unaware enemies from behind to start the fight with an advantage.

    • Added more than 30 new attacks and skill animations.

    • All the enemies now have new attacks to dynamize the combats.

    • Numerous areas visually modified.

    • Modified numerous icons of items, equipment, skills and others.

    • Added new secondary missions (errands) in previous chapters.

    • Modified some secondary missions (errands) to make them more accessible.

    • The now game freezes when the window loses focus.

    • New victory animation for Jövla.

    • New combat sprites (attack and defense).

    • New victory music.

    • New sparkles indicate the interaction possibility with certain objects.

    • Removed the auto-advance in the scenes, read at your own pace.

    • Mouse cursor will hide after 3 seconds if not in use.

    • And many other minor changes and fixes.


Lastly, for those of you who were planning to resume your saved game, we regret to say that this won't be possible. We have added so many new things that it has been impossible to keep the old saved games. We apologize for this.


Enjoy the full EVERING experience!
Purpure Studio

notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.notes:
That's right, the final chapter of EVERING will be released on [u]February 28, 2024[/u]. This also implies the game is leaving Early Access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084367/6c94a7176e258a4a483ee53dc3e31e54ecf89954.png[/img]

This new chapter, with its new cities and plots, does not come alone. We have been working on a new main menu (which you can see [url=https://twitter.com/PurpureSt_/status/1738602275004641289]here[/url]), a new skill system, a new intro, new cutscenes and side quests, remade scenarios... This final version will also include [b]Steam achievements[/b].

[b]Price change:[/b] As with every new chapter, the price will increase to match the game's content. This change will take place on [u]January 28[/u], one month before the launch, in order to offer a discount on release (Steam policy does not allow a discount to be applied until 30 days after a price change). You can take advantage of these next few days to buy EVERING at a reduced price :)

Soon you will be able to enjoy the full EVERING experience!


Thank you!
Purpure Studio.

notes.title: EVERING Chapter 2 is now available!
notes.notes:
The second chapter of [b]EVERING[/b] is finally here!

'[i]Echoes from the Circle[/i]' delves deeper into the story and characters. You'll discover more about the Legend of the Hero, visit new towns and cities and meet more charismatic characters. This new content increases the game's length by 7-8 hours, which added to Chapter I brings the total to 12-14 hours!

In this chapter Eldar and his companions cross the border of Onnya to reach Yest, where they will meet Laric, an apprentice alchemist who knows more than he seems to. Together they will unravel the mysteries surrounding the Legend of the Hero, although they may catch someone's attention...

But that's not all. We have also made numerous changes in the first chapter to improve the game experience (Remember that these changes do not modify the story):

[list]
[*][b]Second chapter![/b] Added new plot, areas, characters, skills, abilities, dungeons, bosses...[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Added the possibility to change the language of the game from the main menu (it is necessary to return to the main menu and restart the game [F5] for the change to take effect)[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Increased amount of experience when using skills (Techniques, Spells, Tricks or Recipes) in combat.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]Totally renewed Magic system.[/b] Magic levels up with each use and new and more powerful magics are unlocked.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Added animations for more status items (Bell, Antidote, Lamp...).[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]New area magics added (Igno Zona is now called [i]Meteor[/i]).[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Lue recovers HP when defending.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]New item: Catalyst. Increases magic damage temporarily.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]New item: Ice bomb. Ice element damage to all enemies.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Added new skill for Eldar in Chapter I: [i]Throw[/i]. It causes damage and may confuse the enemy.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Jövla learns new skills (Gambits) when equipping new weapons.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Added a new skill (Gambit) for Jövla in Chapter I: [i]Sharp Instinct[/i], it allows to see the HP, weaknesses and strengths of the enemy.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Calibrated the probability of appearance of enemies with the Seal of The Keeper.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Added the book "[i]Status Effects[/i]" which explains the status effects and their cure. [/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Added controls tutorial.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]If you missed any skill or magic, Captain Roglan will teach them to you. Look for him in the Palace gym.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Animations for skills and magics completely revamped.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Added the possibility of running away from the fights against bosses and Breach enemies. For now this doesn't affect the development of the plot.[/*][/list]
[list]
[*]Improved the system of side quests. It's now possible to accept a side quest even if it has been rejected (Soon it will be possible to consult the active side quests!). [/*][/list]
[list]
[*]New icons for the stat modifying status effects (Attack, Defense, Agility).[/*][/list]
[list]

[list]

[list]

[list]
[*]Other minor adjustments.[/*][/list]


As we have already told you, due to the extensive changes to the magic system and translation, it won't be possible to transfer and continue a previous save file. Our intention was always to make it possible to keep and continue saved games but, in order to make a better game, we had to make this difficult decision.

As compensation, we've included a chapter selector when starting a new game. By selecting Chapter II, you will travel directly to the new content, with the most convenient level, equipment, items and skills. It also starts with a brief summary of the events to refresh your memory.

The full version of [b]EVERING [/b]will consist of three chapters. Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/purpurest_]Twitter[/url] to know what is coming and take a look a new locations and features.

We want to keep a close relationship with our community, listening carefully to all the feedback you can give us, as well as bug reports and other errors. You can contact us through our [url=https://discord.gg/KNV83JXWjp]Discord[/url] server, [url=https://twitter.com/purpurest_]Twitter [/url]or via [url=mailto:purpurest@gmail.com]email[/url].

Purpure Studio is a 2 people team and, although we put a lot of effort in making sure that there are no bugs, it's likely that there will be some. We want the final version of [b]EVERING [/b]to be bug free and we count on you to help us create a better game.


[b]Thanks,

Purpure Studio :)[/b]

notes.title: EVERING Chapter II: 'Echoes from the Circle' out on January 11
notes.notes:
The wait has been long but it's not long now, the second chapter of [b]EVERING[/b] is very close:
January 11th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084367/71155339f06e4b5da3f7e59ae1ce816fe0721da6.png[/img]

[i]Echoes from the Circle[/i] will take you to discover the next episode in the journey of Eldar and his companions, crossing borders, visiting new locations and meeting new and charismatic characters.

This new chapter adds 7-8 hours of content, reaching a total of [b]12-14 hours[/b]!

We've also made a lot of changes, some small and some big, that we hope will improve your game experience. For example, we've [b]completely revamped Lue's magic system[/b] - magics level up with use and new, more powerful magics will be learned when they reach level 3, and Jövla now learns skills when equipping new weapons. 

It'll be possible to change the game language at any time (English/Spanish) from the main menu (it's necessary to restart the game for the change to take effect). For the rest of the changes made, take a look at the changelog that we'll publish when the game is updated. 

Unfortunately, due to the extensive changes to the magic system and translation, it won't be possible to continue a previous save file. Our intention was always to make it possible to keep and continue saved games but, in order to make a better game, we had to make this difficult decision. 

As compensation, we've included a chapter selector when starting a new game. By selecting Chapter II, you will travel directly to the new content, with the most convenient level, equipment, items and skills. It also starts with a brief summary of the events to refresh your memory.

Finally, we would like to apologize for the delay. As you may know, Purpure Studio is a team of just 2 and at the moment game development is not our main source of income. This, added to the day to day problems have made that this second chapter to be delayed more than we would have liked.

As always, you can follow the progress of EVERING by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/PurpureSt_]Twitter[/url].


We'll keep working hard to complete EVERING!

[b]Thank you, 

Purpure Studio[/b]

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey, Purpure Studio here! 

It's been a while since we've communicated with you and we want to let you know that we are still hard at work on EVERING.

Our plan was to release chapter/update 2 of EVERING during the summer but, clearly, it is not going to be possible. We didn't want to give exact dates to avoid having to announce a delay. After all, EVERING is not our main job, we invest our free time in it. This, coupled with real life situations beyond our control, has led to the fact that we have not been able to fulfill our original plan.

In addition to chapter/update 2, we've also been working on the first part. There will be some minor changes and improvements, especially in graphics and music. We've been very concerned about improving the user experience (UX), new tutorials will make the game more intuitive and easier to play. We want to make it more entertaining to get new skills and magics and less tedious side quests.

As promised, the published story will not be affected by new updates or patches, but it is likely that the gameplay will be altered. As a preview, as an example, Lue's spells will level up with uses and she will learn improved versions when the spell reach a certain level.

[u]TL;DR[/u] Don't worry! The development of the second part is going well and it will be released soon.

You will have news very very soon, but to keep up to date with news about the game and new locations, we recommend you to follow us on Twitter, because we publish new things every week.


Best regards,

Purpure Studio

notes.title: EVERING is OUT!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that [b]EVERING [/b]is now on the Steam store! 

The game is currently on Early Access, and it will be updated as new chapters are released. You won't have to buy the chapters separately, you buy it once and that's it. We want players to experience the story as we develop it and to get involved in the lore of the world we are creating.

The development of the next episodes of [b]EVERING [/b]will take nine months to a year in total, aiming for a full game by Q1 2023. Once we finish a new episode, it will be published and available to play.

'[i]Journey of a Tale[/i]', the first update, is finished and we are already working on the next one. The full version of [b]EVERING [/b]will consist of three chapters. Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/purpurest_]Twitter [/url]to know what is coming and take a look a new locations and features.

We want to keep a close relationship with our community, listening carefully to all the feedback you can give us, as well as bug reports and other errors. You can contact us through our [url=https://discord.gg/KNV83JXWjp]Discord [/url]server, [url=https://twitter.com/purpurest_]Twitter [/url]or via [url=mailto:purpurest@gmail.com]email[/url].

Purpure Studio is a 2 people team and, although we put a lot of effort in making sure that there are no bugs, it's likely that there will be some. We want the final version of [b]EVERING [/b]to be bug free and we count on you to help us create a better game.

We are convinced that we will fulfill this commitment, [b]EVERING [/b]won't be another game that spends years and years in early access. [b]EVERING [/b]will be a full game in 2023.

[b]Thank you,

Purpure Studio :)[/b]
